<script id="kb-safe-storage-v7">/* Jedan bezbjedan pristup skladištu za originalni 2D pogon; stari ključevi ostaju čitljivi. */
(()=>{'use strict';
let native=null;try{native=window.localStorage;}catch(_){}
const memory=new Map(),root='kb_save_v2';let durable=!!native;
function raw(key){if(memory.has(key))return memory.get(key);try{return native?.getItem(key)??null;}catch(_){durable=false;return null;}}
function parse(text,fallback=null){try{return JSON.parse(text)??fallback;}catch(_){return fallback;}}
function write(key,value){memory.set(key,value);try{if(!native)throw Error('Nema skladišta');native.setItem(key,value);durable=true;return true;}catch(_){durable=false;return false;}}
function pool(){const p=parse(raw(root),{});return p&&p.v===2?p:{v:2,manual:null,auto:null,checkpoint:null};}
function valid(d){return d&&d.v===2&&Number.isFinite(d.x)&&Number.isFinite(d.y)&&Number.isFinite(d.at);}
function readSave(key){const p=pool(),a=p[key==='kb_manual_save_v2'?'manual':'auto'],b=parse(raw(key));const out=[a,b].filter(valid).sort((a,b)=>b.at-a.at)[0];return out?JSON.stringify(out):raw(key);}
const store={
 getItem(key){key=String(key);return /^kb_(manual|auto)_save_v2$/.test(key)?readSave(key):raw(key);},
 setItem(key,value){key=String(key);value=String(value);const ok=write(key,value);if(/^kb_(manual|auto)_save_v2$/.test(key)){const d=parse(value);if(valid(d)){const p=pool();p[key==='kb_manual_save_v2'?'manual':'auto']=d;write(root,JSON.stringify(p));}}return ok;},
 removeItem(key){key=String(key);memory.set(key,null);try{native?.removeItem(key);}catch(_){durable=false;}},
 invalidate(){memory.clear();},
 get durable(){return durable;},
 read(key,fallback){return parse(this.getItem(key),fallback);},
 put(key,value){return this.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(value));},
 checkpoint(value){const p=pool();p.checkpoint=value;return write(root,JSON.stringify(p));},
 get checkpointData(){return pool().checkpoint;}
};
const p=pool();let migrate=false;for(const [key,slot]of [['kb_manual_save_v2','manual'],['kb_auto_save_v2','auto']]){const d=parse(raw(key));if(valid(d)&&(!valid(p[slot])||d.at>p[slot].at)){p[slot]=d;migrate=true;}}if(migrate)write(root,JSON.stringify(p));
window.KBStore=store;
})();
</script>

/* KALAČ BRDO v5 — dodatni sloj: zvuk, slika, ceo ekran, FPS, štednja grafike */

const fs=()=>{const d=document,e=d.documentElement;if(d.fullscreenElement||d.webkitFullscreenElement){(d.exitFullscreen||d.webkitExitFullscreen).call(d)}else{const r=e.requestFullscreen||e.webkitRequestFullscreen;if(r)try{const q=r.call(e);q&&q.catch&&q.catch(()=>{})}catch(x){}}};
const toggleMute=()=>{muted=!muted;LS('kb5_mute',muted?'1':'0');applyMute();toast(muted?'🔇 Zvuk isključen':'🔊 Zvuk uključen')};
const toggleEco=()=>{eco=!eco;LS('kb5_eco',eco?'1':'0');low=0;applyEco();toast(eco?'🔋 Štednja grafike: uključena':'✨ Štednja grafike: isključena')};
const toggleFps=()=>{fpsOn=!fpsOn;fpsEl.style.display=fpsOn?'block':'none'};
const wake=async()=>{try{if(live()&&!wl&&navigator.wakeLock&&!document.hidden){wl=await navigator.wakeLock.request('screen');wl.addEventListener('release',()=>{wl=null})}}catch(e){wl=null}};
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{const h=document.hidden;ctxs.forEach(x=>{try{h?x.suspend():x.resume()}catch(e){}});media.forEach(m=>{try{if(h){m.__w=!m.paused;m.pause()}else if(m.__w){m.__w=0;m.play().catch(()=>{})}}catch(e){}});if(!h)wake()});
let bar,btnM,fpsEl;
const ui=()=>{
const el=(h)=>{const t=document.createElement('div');t.innerHTML=h;return t.firstChild};
bar=el('<div id="kb5"><button type="button" data-a="m" title="Zvuk (F9)"></button><button type="button" data-a="s" title="Slika (F2)">📷</button><button type="button" data-a="e" title="Štednja grafike (F8)">🔋</button><button type="button" data-a="f" title="Ceo ekran (F4)">⛶</button></div>');

bar.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>e.stopPropagation());
applyMute();applyEco();
let fr=0,t0=performance.now();
(function f(t){fr++;if(t-t0>=1000){const v=Math.round(fr*1000/(t-t0));fr=0;t0=t;if(fpsOn){fpsEl.textContent=v+' FPS'+(eco?' · eco':'');fpsEl.style.color=v>=50?'#55d67b':v>=30?'#ffd37a':'#ff6a5a'}
low=0}
requestAnimationFrame(f)})(t0);
setInterval(()=>{const on=live();bar.style.display=on?'flex':'none';if(on){wake();if(!hinted){hinted=true;if(!LS('kb5_hint')){LS('kb5_hint','1');setTimeout(()=>toast('F2 slika · F3 FPS · F4 ceo ekran · F8 štednja · F9 zvuk'),2500)}}}},700);
};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const t=e.target;if(t&&(t.isContentEditable||/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName)))return;const k=e.key;if(k==='F2'){e.preventDefault();shot()}else if(k==='F3'){e.preventDefault();toggleFps()}else if(k==='F4'){e.preventDefault();fs()}else if(k==='F8'){e.preventDefault();toggleEco()}else if(k==='F9'){e.preventDefault();toggleMute()}},true);

}catch(err){console.warn('KB5',err)}})();

<script id="kb-light-geometry-v6">/* Zajedničko 2D praćenje zraka za svjetlo i sjenke u svijetu i arkadi. */
(()=>{'use strict';

function raySegment(x,y,dx,dy,s,max){const sx=s[2]-s[0],sy=s[3]-s[1],det=dx*sy-dy*sx;if(Math.abs(det)<1e-9)return null;const qx=s[0]-x,qy=s[1]-y,t=(qx*sy-qy*sx)/det,u=(qx*dy-qy*dx)/det;return t>=.0001&&t<=max&&u>=-1e-7&&u<=1.0000001?t:null;}

class LightField{
 constructor(samples=360){this.samples=samples;this.distances=new Float32Array(samples);this.tops=new Float32Array(samples);this.segments=[];this.grid=new Map();this.seen=new Uint32Array(0);this.stamp=0;this.serial=0;this.cell=8;this.range=1;this.x=this.y=0;this.rays=0;}

 cast(angle){const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle),cell=this.cell,stepX=dx>=0?1:-1,stepY=dy>=0?1:-1;let cx=Math.floor(this.x/cell),cy=Math.floor(this.y/cell),nextX=Math.abs(dx)<1e-12?Infinity:((cx+(stepX>0?1:0))*cell-this.x)/dx,nextY=Math.abs(dy)<1e-12?Infinity:((cy+(stepY>0?1:0))*cell-this.y)/dy,deltaX=Math.abs(cell/dx),deltaY=Math.abs(cell/dy),d=this.range,top=-1e5;const stamp=++this.stamp;for(let n=0;n<48;n++){const bucket=this.grid.get((cx+32768)*65536+cy+32768);if(bucket)for(const i of bucket){if(this.seen[i]===stamp)continue;this.seen[i]=stamp;const s=this.segments[i],hit=raySegment(this.x,this.y,dx,dy,s,d);if(hit!==null){d=hit;top=s[4]??10;}}if(d<=Math.min(nextX,nextY)+1e-7)break;if(nextX<nextY){cx+=stepX;nextX+=deltaX;}else{cy+=stepY;nextY+=deltaY;}if(Math.min(nextX,nextY)>this.range+cell)break;}this.rays++;return {x:this.x+dx*d,y:this.y+dy*d,d,top};}

 polygon(angle=0,half=Math.PI,precision=true){const full=half>=Math.PI-.001,angles=[],start=angle-half,end=angle+half,step=TAU/this.samples;for(let a=start;a<=end+step*.3;a+=step)angles.push(Math.min(end,a));angles.push(end);if(precision){for(const s of this.segments)for(const p of [[s[0],s[1]],[s[2],s[3]]]){const a=angle+wrap(Math.atan2(p[1]-this.y,p[0]-this.x)-angle);if(a>=start&&a<=end)for(const e of [-.0002,0,.0002])if(a+e>=start&&a+e<=end)angles.push(a+e);}}angles.sort((a,b)=>a-b);const out=[];let old=-Infinity;for(const a of angles){if(a-old<.00001)continue;old=a;if(precision)out.push(this.cast(a));else {const d=this.distance(a);out.push({x:this.x+Math.cos(a)*d,y:this.y+Math.sin(a)*d,d});}}return {x:this.x,y:this.y,full,points:out};}

</script><script id="kb-quick-core-v6">/* Fizika i uslovi pobede odvojeni su od Canvas prikaza i DOM-a. */
(()=>{'use strict';const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
class FreeKick{
 constructor(random=Math.random){this.random=random;this.attempt=0;this.goals=0;this.points=0;this.phase='aim';this.power=.72;this.angle=-8;this.lift=14;this.spin=.2;this.time=0;this.message='Namesti ugao i felš. Space ili ŠUT.';this.keeper={x:0,vx:0};this.resetBall();}
 resetBall(){this.ball={x:0,y:.22,z:0,vx:0,vy:0,vz:0,spin:0};this.trail=[];}
 shoot(){if(this.phase!=='aim'||this.attempt>=5)return false;this.attempt++;this.resetBall();const speed=15+this.power*14,yaw=this.angle*Math.PI/180,elev=this.lift*Math.PI/180;Object.assign(this.ball,{vx:Math.sin(yaw)*Math.cos(elev)*speed,vz:Math.cos(yaw)*Math.cos(elev)*speed,vy:Math.sin(elev)*speed,spin:this.spin*8});this.phase='flight';this.flight=0;this.message='Lopta je u letu…';return true;}
 finish(message,goal=false,target=false){if(this.phase!=='flight')return;this.phase='result';this.wait=1.6;this.message=message;if(goal){this.goals++;this.points+=target?3:1;}this.lastGoal=goal;this.lastTarget=target;}
 step(dt){dt=clamp(dt,0,.05);this.time+=dt;if(this.phase==='result'){this.wait-=dt;if(this.wait<=0){if(this.attempt>=5)this.phase='over';else{this.phase='aim';this.resetBall();}}return;}if(this.phase!=='flight')return;this.flight+=dt;const b=this.ball;
  const want=this.flight>.23?clamp(b.x+b.vx*.23,-2.9,2.9):0;this.keeper.vx=clamp((want-this.keeper.x)*7,-4.5,4.5);this.keeper.x+=this.keeper.vx*dt;
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const h=dt/3,old={x:b.x,y:b.y,z:b.z};b.vx+=b.vz*b.spin*.055*h;b.vz-=b.vx*b.spin*.055*h;b.vy-=9.81*h;b.x+=b.vx*h;b.z+=b.vz*h;b.y+=b.vy*h;b.spin*=Math.exp(-h*.18);
   if(old.z<9.8&&b.z>=9.8){const t=(9.8-old.z)/(b.z-old.z),x=old.x+(b.x-old.x)*t,y=old.y+(b.y-old.y)*t;if([-1.1,0,1.1].some(a=>Math.abs(x-a)<.42)&&y<1.85){this.finish('ŽIVI ZID · probaj više ili obiđi felšom.');return;}}
   if(old.z<17.15&&b.z>=17.15){const t=(17.15-old.z)/(b.z-old.z),x=old.x+(b.x-old.x)*t,y=old.y+(b.y-old.y)*t;if(Math.abs(x-this.keeper.x)<.62&&y<1.82&&y>.05){this.finish('ODBRANA · vrh gola je slobodniji.');return;}}
   if(old.z<18&&b.z>=18){const t=(18-old.z)/(b.z-old.z),x=old.x+(b.x-old.x)*t,y=old.y+(b.y-old.y)*t;if(Math.abs(x)<3.66-.22&&y>.13&&y<2.44-.22){const target=[-2.65,2.65].some(a=>Math.hypot(x-a,y-1.82)<.65);this.finish(target?'GORNJI UGAO · +3':'GOL · +1',true,target);}else this.finish(y>2.22?'PREKO PREČKE':'PORED GOLA');return;}
   if(b.y<.22){b.y=.22;b.vy=Math.abs(b.vy)*.48;b.vx*=.92;b.vz*=.92;}if(this.flight>4||Math.abs(b.x)>14||b.z>25){this.finish('LOPTA JE IZAŠLA.');return;}}

 }
}
class SignalLock{
 constructor(random=Math.random){this.base=3.4+random()*3.0;this.phaseTarget=random()*Math.PI*2;this.ampTarget=.55+random()*.28;this.frequency=4;this.phase=0;this.amplitude=.65;this.elapsed=0;this.duration=45;this.progress=0;this.state='playing';}
 target(){return {frequency:this.base+Math.sin(this.elapsed*.32)*.025,phase:this.phaseTarget+Math.sin(this.elapsed*.24)*.025,amplitude:this.ampTarget};}
 error(){const t=this.target();return {frequency:Math.abs(t.frequency-this.frequency),phase:Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(t.phase-this.phase),Math.cos(t.phase-this.phase))),amplitude:Math.abs(t.amplitude-this.amplitude)};}
 step(dt){if(this.state!=='playing')return;this.elapsed+=dt;const e=this.error(),ok=e.frequency<.12&&e.phase<.15&&e.amplitude<.075;this.progress=clamp(this.progress+dt*(ok?1:-.7),0,2.5);if(this.progress>=2.5)this.state='decoded';else if(this.elapsed>=this.duration)this.state='expired';}
}
window.KBQuickGames={FreeKick,SignalLock};})();
</script>
<script id="kb-original-launch-queue">addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest?.('[data-kb-original-2d]');if(!b||window.KBOriginal2D)return;e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();window.__kbClassicPending=true;if(!b.dataset.kbLaunchLabel)b.dataset.kbLaunchLabel=b.innerHTML;b.textContent='UČITAVANJE IGRE…'},true);</script>
<script id="kb-b1-games">
/* B1 · dve čiste SPX fabrike, relativni sat, deterministički raspored. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const TAU=Math.PI*2, clone=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
  const clamp=(x,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)), finite=(x,a,b)=>Number.isFinite(x)&&x>=a&&x<=b;
  const assert=(ok,m)=>{if(!ok)throw Error(m||'Neispravan B1 snimak.');};
  const plain=x=>x!==null&&typeof x==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x)&&Object.getPrototypeOf(x)===Object.prototype;
  const norm=a=>(a%TAU+TAU)%TAU, delta=(a,b)=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-b),Math.cos(a-b));
  function rng(seed){let s=seed>>>0;return()=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296;};}
  function base(s,kind){assert(plain(s)&&s.version===1&&s.kind===kind);assert(Number.isInteger(s.seed)&&finite(s.seed,0,4294967295));assert(Number.isInteger(s.difficulty)&&finite(s.difficulty,0,2));assert(typeof s.risk==='boolean'&&typeof s.active==='boolean');assert(['playing','won','lost'].includes(s.status));assert(finite(s.elapsed,0,600)&&finite(s.score,0,100));}
  function radioConfig(d,risk,focus){return {duration:[100,80,65][d],window:[.16,.115,.08][d],hold:(focus?.8:1.2)*(risk?.72:1),radius:[.13,.10,.08][d]};}
  function geometry(seed){const r=rng(seed);return {target:{x:.33+r()*.34,z:.32+r()*.30},stations:[{x:.14,z:.82},{x:.86,z:.80},{x:.50,z:.10}]};}
  function validateRadio(s){
    base(s,'radio');assert(typeof s.focus==='boolean');assert(finite(s.angle,0,TAU)&&finite(s.stable,0,4));
    assert(Number.isInteger(s.mistakes)&&finite(s.mistakes,0,30));assert(plain(s.cursor)&&finite(s.cursor.x,0,1)&&finite(s.cursor.z,0,1));
    assert(Array.isArray(s.measurements)&&s.measurements.length<=3);s.measurements.forEach(m=>assert(plain(m)&&finite(m.angle,0,TAU)&&finite(m.error,0,Math.PI)));
    assert(s.elapsed<=radioConfig(s.difficulty,s.risk,s.focus).duration+10);return clone(s);
  }
  function createRadio(){
    let s=null;
    function view(){if(!s)return null;const g=geometry(s.seed),c=radioConfig(s.difficulty,s.risk,s.focus),i=Math.min(2,s.measurements.length),p=g.stations[i],bearing=norm(Math.atan2(g.target.z-p.z,g.target.x-p.x));
      const error=delta(bearing,s.angle),interference=Math.sin(s.elapsed*1.7+s.seed%17)*[.008,.016,.022][s.difficulty]*(s.risk?1.8:1);
      return {...clone(s),...g,station:i,bearing,error,power:clamp(1-Math.abs(error+interference)/.65,0,1),pan:clamp(error/.8,-1,1),remaining:Math.max(0,c.duration-s.elapsed),hold:c.hold,window:c.window};}
    function finish(won){s.status=won?'won':'lost';s.active=false;if(won){const c=radioConfig(s.difficulty,s.risk,s.focus),err=s.measurements.reduce((n,m)=>n+m.error,0)/3;s.score=Math.round(clamp(100-err/c.window*16-s.mistakes*6-Math.max(0,s.elapsed/c.duration-.35)*10+(s.risk?3:0),0,100));}else s.score=0;}
    return {id:'b1_radio',
      start(ctx,p={}){const d=Number.isInteger(p.difficulty)?clamp(p.difficulty,0,2):0;s={version:1,kind:'radio',seed:(p.seed??112026)>>>0,difficulty:d,risk:!!p.risk,focus:!!p.focus,active:true,status:'playing',elapsed:0,score:0,angle:0,stable:0,mistakes:0,measurements:[],cursor:{x:.5,z:.5}};return true;},
      update(ctx,dt){if(!s?.active||!finite(dt,0,.25)||dt===0)return;const v=view();s.elapsed+=dt;if(s.measurements.length<3)s.stable=Math.abs(v.error)<=v.window&&v.power>.7?Math.min(4,s.stable+dt):Math.max(0,s.stable-dt*2);if(s.elapsed>=radioConfig(s.difficulty,s.risk,s.focus).duration)finish(false);},
      interact(ctx,a={}){if(!s?.active)return false;
        if(a.type==='angle'&&Number.isFinite(a.value)){s.angle=norm(a.value);s.stable=Math.min(s.stable,.2);return true;}
        if(a.type==='turn'&&Number.isFinite(a.value)){s.angle=norm(s.angle+clamp(a.value,-.3,.3));if(Math.abs(a.value)>.035)s.stable=0;return true;}
        if(a.type==='cursor'&&finite(a.x,0,1)&&finite(a.z,0,1)){s.cursor={x:a.x,z:a.z};return true;}
        if(a.type!=='confirm')return false;
        const v=view();
        if(s.measurements.length<3){if(s.stable<v.hold){s.mistakes++;s.stable=0;s.elapsed+=2;}else{s.measurements.push({angle:s.angle,error:Math.abs(v.error)});s.stable=0;s.angle=norm(s.angle+1.1);}}
        else if(Math.hypot(s.cursor.x-v.target.x,s.cursor.z-v.target.z)<=radioConfig(s.difficulty,s.risk,s.focus).radius)finish(true);
        else{s.mistakes++;s.elapsed+=4;}
        if(s.active&&(s.mistakes>=8||s.elapsed>=radioConfig(s.difficulty,s.risk,s.focus).duration))finish(false);return true;
      },
      stop(ctx,reason){if(s)s.active=false;},serialize(){return clone(s);},restore(obj){s=validateRadio(obj);if(s.status==='playing')s.active=true;return true;},debug:view
    };
  }
  function toneChart(seed,difficulty,risk){const r=rng(seed),bpm=[76,94,112][difficulty]*(risk?1.12:1),beat=60/bpm,notes=[];let time=3;
    const motifs=[[0,2,1,3],[0,2,1,0,3,2],[0,2,1,3,2,0,1,3]];
    for(let phrase=0;phrase<3;phrase++){const shift=phrase===0?0:Math.floor(r()*4);for(let j=0;j<motifs[phrase].length;j++){notes.push({lane:(motifs[phrase][j]+shift)%4,time,phrase});time+=beat*(difficulty===2&&phrase===2&&j%3===1?.5:1);}time+=2.4;}
    return {notes,bpm,end:notes[notes.length-1].time+1.2,window:[.24,.19,.145][difficulty]};
  }
  function validateTones(s){base(s,'tones');const c=toneChart(s.seed,s.difficulty,s.risk);assert(Array.isArray(s.hits)&&s.hits.length===c.notes.length&&s.hits.every(x=>finite(x,-1,1)));assert(Number.isInteger(s.errors)&&finite(s.errors,0,2000));assert(s.elapsed<=c.end+.5);return clone(s);}
  function createTones(){let s=null;
    function view(){return s?{...clone(s),...toneChart(s.seed,s.difficulty,s.risk)}:null;}
    return {id:'b1_four_tones',
      start(ctx,p={}){const d=Number.isInteger(p.difficulty)?clamp(p.difficulty,0,2):0,seed=(p.seed??112026)>>>0,risk=!!p.risk;s={version:1,kind:'tones',seed,difficulty:d,risk,active:true,status:'playing',elapsed:0,score:0,hits:toneChart(seed,d,risk).notes.map(()=>0),errors:0};return true;},
      update(ctx,dt){if(!s?.active||!finite(dt,0,.25)||dt===0)return;const c=toneChart(s.seed,s.difficulty,s.risk);s.elapsed+=dt;
        c.notes.forEach((n,i)=>{if(s.hits[i]===0&&s.elapsed>n.time+c.window)s.hits[i]=-1;});
        if(s.elapsed>=c.end){s.score=Math.round(clamp(s.hits.reduce((a,x)=>a+Math.max(0,x),0)/s.hits.length*100-s.errors*.8+(s.risk?3:0),0,100));s.status=s.score>=[55,60,65][s.difficulty]?'won':'lost';s.active=false;}
      },
      interact(ctx,a={}){if(!s?.active||a.type!=='note'||!Number.isInteger(a.lane)||a.lane<0||a.lane>3)return false;const c=toneChart(s.seed,s.difficulty,s.risk);let best=-1,err=Infinity;
        for(let i=0;i<c.notes.length;i++){const n=c.notes[i],e=Math.abs(n.time-s.elapsed);if(n.lane===a.lane&&s.hits[i]===0&&e<=c.window&&e<err){best=i;err=e;}}
        if(best<0)s.errors++;else s.hits[best]=1-err/c.window*.45;return best>=0;
      },stop(ctx,reason){if(s)s.active=false;},serialize(){return clone(s);},restore(obj){s=validateTones(obj);if(s.status==='playing')s.active=true;return true;},debug:view
    };
  }
  function validateCheckpoint(c){
    assert(plain(c)&&c.version===1);assert(Number.isInteger(c.stage)&&finite(c.stage,-1,6));
    assert(['story','practice'].includes(c.mode));assert(finite(c.seed,0,4294967295)&&Number.isInteger(c.seed));
    assert(Number.isInteger(c.difficulty)&&finite(c.difficulty,0,2));assert(typeof c.risk==='boolean');
    assert(finite(c.elapsed,0,100000)&&finite(c.alert,0,1)&&finite(c.hold,0,6));
    assert(Array.isArray(c.visited)&&c.visited.length<=2&&new Set(c.visited).size===c.visited.length&&c.visited.every(x=>x===0||x===1));
    assert(Array.isArray(c.scores)&&c.scores.length<=2&&c.scores.every(x=>finite(x,0,100)));
    if(c.position!==null)assert(plain(c.position)&&finite(c.position.x,-1000,1000)&&finite(c.position.z,-1000,1000));
    if(c.game!==null){if(c.game.kind==='radio')validateRadio(c.game);else validateTones(c.game);}
    return clone(c);
  }
  window.KBB1Games=Object.freeze({createRadio,createTones,validateCheckpoint,validateRadio,validateTones,geometry,toneChart,delta});
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-b2-games">
/* B2: foto-lov i strujna kola. Čiste SPX fabrike, bez sopstvenog sata. */
(() => {'use strict';
 const copy=v=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v)),clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
 const finite=(v,a,b)=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=a&&v<=b,int=(v,a,b)=>Number.isInteger(v)&&finite(v,a,b);
 const obj=v=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)&&[Object.prototype,null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(v));
 const check=(ok,msg='Neispravan B2 snimak.')=>{if(!ok)throw Error(msg);};
 const random=seed=>{let s=seed>>>0;return()=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296;};};
 const dtOK=dt=>finite(dt,0,.25)&&dt>0;
 function base(v,kind){check(obj(v)&&v.version===1&&v.kind===kind&&int(v.seed,0,4294967295)&&int(v.difficulty,0,2));check(typeof v.risk==='boolean'&&typeof v.active==='boolean'&&['playing','won','lost'].includes(v.status));check(finite(v.elapsed,0,601)&&finite(v.score,0,100));check(v.status==='playing'||!v.active);}
 function photoConfig(v){return {duration:[110,90,75][v.difficulty],radius:[.055,.042,.032][v.difficulty]*(v.risk?.75:1),hold:(v.risk?.5:.8),cycle:6,window:[3.8,3.2,2.7][v.difficulty]+(v.assist?.4:0),battery:[9,8,7][v.difficulty]+(v.cell?2:0)+(v.assist?1:0)-(v.risk?1:0)};}
 function photoTarget(v){const r=random(v.seed+v.phase*31991),x=.22+r()*.56,y=.26+r()*.4;return {x:clamp(x+(v.steady?0:Math.sin(v.elapsed*.7+v.phase)*(.008+v.difficulty*.006)),.15,.85),y};}
 function photoView(v){const c=photoConfig(v),target=photoTarget(v),phaseTime=v.elapsed-v.phaseAt,visible=v.finder&&phaseTime%c.cycle<c.window;
  return {...c,...copy(v),target,visible,remaining:Math.max(0,c.duration-v.elapsed),distance:Math.hypot(v.aim.x-target.x,v.aim.y-target.y),names:['Senka antene','Prozor bez sobe','Trag iza ograde']};}
 function validatePhoto(v){base(v,'photo');check(typeof v.cell==='boolean'&&typeof v.assist==='boolean'&&typeof v.finder==='boolean'&&typeof v.steady==='boolean');check(int(v.phase,0,3)&&finite(v.phaseAt,0,v.elapsed)&&obj(v.aim)&&finite(v.aim.x,.08,.92)&&finite(v.aim.y,.12,.88));check(finite(v.focus,0,2)&&finite(v.cooldown,0,2)&&int(v.shots,0,20)&&int(v.misses,0,20));const c=photoConfig(v);check(int(v.battery,0,c.battery)&&v.shots+v.battery===c.battery&&v.shots===v.phase+v.misses);check(Array.isArray(v.photos)&&v.photos.length===v.phase&&v.photos.every(x=>finite(x,0,100)));check(v.elapsed<=c.duration+.25);check(v.status!=='won'||v.phase===3);return copy(v);}
 function createPhoto(){let s=null;
  function lose(){s.active=false;s.status='lost';s.score=0;}
  return {id:'b2_photo',start(ctx,p={}){s={version:1,kind:'photo',seed:(p.seed??20261113)>>>0,difficulty:int(p.difficulty,0,2)?p.difficulty:0,risk:!!p.risk,cell:!!p.cell,assist:!!p.assist,steady:!!p.steady,active:true,status:'playing',elapsed:0,score:0,phase:0,phaseAt:0,aim:{x:.5,y:.5},finder:false,focus:0,cooldown:0,shots:0,misses:0,battery:0,photos:[]};s.battery=photoConfig(s).battery;return true;},
   update(ctx,dt){if(!s?.active||!dtOK(dt))return;s.elapsed+=dt;s.cooldown=Math.max(0,s.cooldown-dt);const v=photoView(s);s.focus=v.visible&&v.distance<=v.radius?Math.min(2,s.focus+dt):Math.max(0,s.focus-dt*3);if(s.elapsed>=v.duration)lose();},
   interact(ctx,a={}){if(!s?.active)return false;if(a.type==='aim'&&finite(a.x,.08,.92)&&finite(a.y,.12,.88)){const shift=Math.hypot(a.x-s.aim.x,a.y-s.aim.y);s.aim={x:a.x,y:a.y};if(shift>.025)s.focus=0;return true;}
    if(a.type==='finder'){s.finder=typeof a.value==='boolean'?a.value:!s.finder;s.focus=0;return true;}
    if(a.type!=='shoot'||s.cooldown>0)return false;const v=photoView(s);s.cooldown=.6;s.shots++;s.battery--;
    if(v.visible&&v.distance<=v.radius&&s.focus>=v.hold){s.photos.push(Math.round(clamp(100-v.distance/v.radius*15+(s.risk?3:0),0,100)));s.phase++;s.phaseAt=s.elapsed;s.focus=0;if(s.phase===3){s.score=Math.round(clamp(s.photos.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/3-s.misses*7-Math.max(0,s.elapsed/v.duration-.5)*8,0,100));s.status='won';s.active=false;}}
    else{s.misses++;s.focus=0;}if(s.active&&s.battery===0)lose();return true;
   },stop(){if(s)s.active=false;},serialize:()=>copy(s),restore(v){const next=validatePhoto(v);if(next.status==='playing')next.active=true;s=next;return true;},debug:()=>s?photoView(s):null};
 }
 const dirs=[[-1,0,1,4],[0,1,2,8],[1,0,4,1],[0,-1,8,2]];
 function rotate(mask,n=1){for(let i=0;i<n%4;i++)mask=((mask<<1)&15)|(mask>>3);return mask;}
 function circuitBoard(seed,difficulty,phase){const n=3+difficulty,r=random((seed+phase*7919)>>>0),last=n*n-1,path=[0],seen=new Set([0]);
  function walk(i){if(i===last)return true;const row=Math.floor(i/n),col=i%n,next=[];for(const [dr,dc]of dirs){const rr=row+dr,cc=col+dc;if(rr>=0&&rr<n&&cc>=0&&cc<n&&!seen.has(rr*n+cc))next.push(rr*n+cc);}for(let k=next.length-1;k>0;k--){const j=Math.floor(r()*(k+1));[next[k],next[j]]=[next[j],next[k]];}for(const q of next){seen.add(q);path.push(q);if(walk(q))return true;path.pop();seen.delete(q);}return false;}
  walk(0);const masks=Array.from({length:n*n},()=>[3,5,6,9,10,12][Math.floor(r()*6)]),ground=[];
  for(let j=0;j<path.length;j++){const i=path[j];let mask=0;if(j===0)mask|=8;else{const d=path[j-1]-i;mask|=d===-n?1:d===1?2:d===n?4:8;}if(j===path.length-1)mask|=2;else{const d=path[j+1]-i;mask|=d===-n?1:d===1?2:d===n?4:8;}masks[i]=mask;}
  for(let i=0;i<n*n;i++)if(!seen.has(i)&&r()<.22+phase*.1)ground.push(i);
  const initial=masks.map(()=>Math.floor(r()*4));if(initial.every((o,i)=>!seen.has(i)||rotate(masks[i],o)===masks[i]))initial[0]=(initial[0]+1)%4;
  return {n,masks,ground,initial,path};
 }
 function circuitNet(board,angles){const {n,masks,ground}=board,pieces=masks.map((m,i)=>rotate(m,angles[i])),powered=[],faults=[];if(!(pieces[0]&8))return {powered, faults:[0],connected:false,ok:false};
  const q=[0],seen=new Set(q);while(q.length){const i=q.shift();powered.push(i);if(ground.includes(i))faults.push(i);const row=Math.floor(i/n),col=i%n;
   for(const [dr,dc,bit,back]of dirs){if(!(pieces[i]&bit))continue;const rr=row+dr,cc=col+dc;if(rr<0||rr>=n||cc<0||cc>=n){if(!(i===0&&bit===8)&&!(i===n*n-1&&bit===2))faults.push(i);continue;}const k=rr*n+cc;if(!(pieces[k]&back)){faults.push(i);continue;}if(!seen.has(k)){seen.add(k);q.push(k);}}
  }const connected=seen.has(n*n-1)&&!!(pieces[n*n-1]&2);return {powered,faults:[...new Set(faults)],connected,ok:connected&&!faults.length};
 }
 const circuitConfig=s=>({duration:[240,240,270][s.difficulty],fuses:[5,4,3][s.difficulty]+(s.reserve?1:0)-(s.risk?1:0)});
 function validateCircuit(v){base(v,'circuit');check(typeof v.reserve==='boolean'&&typeof v.power==='boolean'&&int(v.phase,0,3)&&int(v.moves,0,10000)&&int(v.strikes,0,10));const c=circuitConfig(v),b=circuitBoard(v.seed,v.difficulty,Math.min(v.phase,2));check(Array.isArray(v.angles)&&v.angles.length===b.n*b.n&&v.angles.every(x=>int(x,0,3)));check(int(v.fuses,0,c.fuses)&&v.fuses+v.strikes===c.fuses&&v.elapsed<=c.duration+.25);check(v.status!=='won'||v.phase===3);return copy(v);}
 function createCircuit(){let s=null,board=null;const view=()=>s?{...circuitConfig(s),...copy(s),board:copy(board),net:circuitNet(board,s.angles),remaining:Math.max(0,circuitConfig(s).duration-s.elapsed)}:null;
  function install(){board=circuitBoard(s.seed,s.difficulty,Math.min(2,s.phase));s.angles=board.initial.slice();s.power=false;}
  function lose(){s.status='lost';s.active=false;s.score=0;}
  return {id:'b2_circuit',start(ctx,p={}){s={version:1,kind:'circuit',seed:(p.seed??20261113)>>>0,difficulty:int(p.difficulty,0,2)?p.difficulty:0,risk:!!p.risk,reserve:!!p.reserve,active:true,status:'playing',elapsed:0,score:0,phase:0,moves:0,strikes:0,fuses:0,power:false,angles:[]};s.fuses=circuitConfig(s).fuses;install();return true;},
   update(ctx,dt){if(!s?.active||!dtOK(dt))return;s.elapsed+=dt;if(s.elapsed>=circuitConfig(s).duration)lose();},
   interact(ctx,a={}){if(!s?.active)return false;if(a.type==='rotate'&&int(a.index,0,s.angles.length-1)){if(s.power)return false;s.angles[a.index]=(s.angles[a.index]+1)%4;s.moves=Math.min(10000,s.moves+1);return true;}
    if(a.type==='off'){s.power=false;return true;}if(a.type!=='test'||s.power)return false;s.power=true;const net=circuitNet(board,s.angles);
    if(net.ok){s.phase++;if(s.phase===3){s.status='won';s.active=false;s.score=Math.round(clamp(100-s.strikes*9-Math.max(0,s.moves-80)*.13-Math.max(0,s.elapsed/circuitConfig(s).duration-.55)*12+(s.risk?3:0),0,100));}else install();}
    else{s.fuses--;s.strikes++;if(!s.fuses)lose();}return true;
   },stop(){if(s)s.active=false;},serialize:()=>copy(s),restore(v){const next=validateCircuit(v);if(next.status==='playing')next.active=true;s=next;board=circuitBoard(s.seed,s.difficulty,Math.min(s.phase,2));return true;},debug:view};
 }
 function validateCheckpoint(v){check(obj(v)&&v.version===1&&['story','practice'].includes(v.mode)&&int(v.stage,-1,6)&&int(v.seed,0,4294967295));check(['photo','circuit'].includes(v.kind)&&int(v.difficulty,0,2)&&typeof v.risk==='boolean');check(finite(v.elapsed,0,100000)&&finite(v.hold,0,4)&&int(v.grounds,0,3)&&int(v.mistakes,0,100)&&Array.isArray(v.scores)&&v.scores.length<=2&&v.scores.every(x=>finite(x,0,100)));check(v.position===null||obj(v.position)&&finite(v.position.x,-1000,1000)&&finite(v.position.z,-1000,1000));if(v.game!==null){check(obj(v.game));if(v.game.kind==='photo')validatePhoto(v.game);else validateCircuit(v.game);check(v.kind===v.game.kind);check(v.mode==='practice'||v.stage===(v.kind==='photo'?1:3));}return copy(v);}
 window.KBB2Games=Object.freeze({createPhoto,createCircuit,validatePhoto,validateCircuit,validateCheckpoint,circuitBoard,circuitNet,rotate});
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-mission-director-a1">
/* KALAČ BRDO · Mission Director A1 · ES2020 · bez mreže i sopstvene petlje. */
(() => {
  'use strict';

    }
    function resume() {
      const id = state.campaign.active; if (!id || !definitions.has(id) || state.campaign.missions[id].status !== 'paused') return false;
      const next = copy(state); next.campaign.missions[id].status = 'active'; return commit(next);
    }
    function tick(dt, env = {}) {
      if (blocked || !Number.isFinite(dt) || dt <= 0 || dt > .25 || env.paused) return;
      const id = state.campaign.active, d = definitions.get(id), m = state.campaign.missions[id];
      if (d && d.engine === env.engine && m.status === 'active') { m.elapsed = Math.min(86400 * 365, m.elapsed + dt); dirty = true; }
      elapsedSinceFlush += dt; if (dirty && elapsedSinceFlush >= 5) flush();
    }
    function restore(input, mergeProfile = false) {
      const next = validate(input);
      for (const [id, d] of definitions) {
        const m = next.campaign.missions[id]; if (!m) continue;
        assert(m.definitionVersion === d.version && m.stage < d.stages.length, 'Nekompatibilna faza misije.');
        const goals = new Map(d.stages.flatMap(s => s.goals.map(g => [g.id, g])));
        Object.keys(m.counts).forEach(k => assert(goals.has(k) && m.counts[k] <= goals.get(k).target, 'Neispravan cilj u snimku.'));
      }
      if (mergeProfile) {
        Object.assign(next.profile.awards, state.profile.awards); Object.assign(next.profile.unlocks, state.profile.unlocks);
        for (const [k, r] of Object.entries(state.profile.records)) {
          const n = next.profile.records[k];
          if (!n || r.score > n.score || r.score === n.score && r.elapsed < n.elapsed) next.profile.records[k] = copy(r);
        }
      }
      blocked = false; return commit(next);
    }
    function load() {
      const raw = read(key);
      if (raw !== null) {
        try { state = validate(JSON.parse(raw)); dirty = false; blocked = false; durable = true; }
        catch (e) { blocked = true; durable = false; note('load-protected', e); }
      } else { blocked = false; state = fromLegacy(); dirty = true; flush(); }
    }
    legacyDefinitions.forEach(register); load();
    function setModule(id,data,persist=false) {
      if(blocked)return false;const api=id==='story.b1'?window.KBB1Games:id==='story.b2'?window.KBB2Games:null;assert(api,'Nepoznat modul.');
      const value=api.validateCheckpoint(data),next=copy(state);
      next.campaign.modules=next.campaign.modules||{};next.campaign.modules[id]=value;return commit(next,persist);
    }
    function recordGame(kind,difficulty,score,elapsed) {
      if(blocked)return false;assert(['radio','tones','photo','circuit'].includes(kind)&&Number.isInteger(difficulty)&&difficulty>=0&&difficulty<=2&&finite(score,100)&&finite(elapsed,600),'Neispravan rezultat.');
      const next=copy(state),id='game.'+kind+'.'+difficulty,old=next.profile.records[id];
      if(old&&(old.score>score||old.score===score&&old.elapsed<=elapsed))return true;
      next.profile.records[id]={score,elapsed,medal:score>=95?3:score>=80?2:score>=60?1:0,at:now()};return commit(next);
    }
    return Object.freeze({version: '1.2.0-B2', key, register, available, start, signal, choose, fail, pause, resume, tick, flush,setModule,recordGame,
      module:id=>copy(state.campaign.modules?.[id]||null),
      serialize: () => copy(state), validate, restore,
      get catalog() { return [...definitions.values()].map(copy); },
      get status() { return {durable, dirty, blocked, active: state.campaign.active, revision: state.revision, diagnostics: copy(diagnostics)}; },
      subscribe(fn) { assert(typeof fn === 'function', 'Listener mora biti funkcija.'); listeners.add(fn); return () => listeners.delete(fn); },
      report: note,
      observeClassic(v) {
        if (blocked) return false; classicCheck(v);
        // Vreme trke se čuva uz izričito snimanje; ne pišemo skladište svakim frejmom.
        if (JSON.stringify(state.campaign.legacy.classic) === JSON.stringify(v)) return true;
        const next = copy(state); applyClassic(next, v); return commit(next, false);
      },
      observeBeta(v) {
        if (blocked || !v || !v.on && !v.complete) return false;
        const before = JSON.stringify([state.campaign.legacy.beta, state.campaign.flags]);
        const next = copy(state); applyBeta(next, v);
        if (before === JSON.stringify([next.campaign.legacy.beta, next.campaign.flags])) return true;
        return commit(next);
      },
      beginBeta(flags) {
        if (blocked) return false;
        flagsCheck(flags || {});
        const next = copy(state);
        const retained={};for(const k of Object.keys(next.campaign.flags))if(k.startsWith('b1')||k.startsWith('b2')||k==='zapisPodeljen')retained[k]=next.campaign.flags[k];
        next.campaign.flags = {...retained,...copy(flags || {})};
        next.campaign.legacy.beta = null;
        for (const id of ['legacy.3d.park','legacy.3d.power','legacy.3d.station']) delete next.campaign.missions[id];
        return commit(next);
      },
      addDossier(d) {
        if (blocked || !d || !idOK(d.id) || typeof d.title !== 'string' || typeof d.body !== 'string') return false;
        if (state.campaign.dossiers.some(x => x.id === d.id)) return true;
        const next = copy(state); if (next.campaign.dossiers.length >= 128) return false;
        next.campaign.dossiers.push({id: d.id, title: d.title.slice(0, 180), body: d.body.slice(0, 1200)}); return commit(next);
      },
      classicSnapshot: () => copy(state.campaign.legacy.classic),
      migrated: values => validate(fromLegacy(values)),
      reload: load
    });
  }
  let storage = null; try { storage = window.localStorage; } catch (_) {}
  const director = create({storage});
  window.KBMissionDirector = Object.freeze({create, validate, key: KEY, instance: director});
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-director-adapters-a1">
/* A1 adapteri: izričite kuke u originalnom kodu, bez prepisivanja prototipova. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const root = window.KBMissionDirector, D = root.instance, hosts = new Map();
  function safe(fn, fallback = null) {
    try { return fn(D); } catch (e) { D.report('adapter', e); return fallback; }
  }
  function validateNative(data, mode) {
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) throw Error('Nedostaje snimak igre.');
    if (mode === 'story') {
      if (data.version !== 5 || !Number.isInteger(data.chapter) || data.chapter < 0 || data.chapter > 2 ||
        !Number.isInteger(data.step) || data.step < 0 || data.step > 100 || !Number.isInteger(data.active) ||
        data.active < 0 || data.active > 2 || !Array.isArray(data.actors) || data.actors.length !== 3 ||
        data.actors.some(a => !a || !['x', 'z', 'yaw'].every(k => Number.isFinite(a[k])))) throw Error('Neispravan snimak priče.');
    } else if (mode === 'free') {
      if (!Number.isFinite(data.x) || !Number.isFinite(data.z)) throw Error('Neispravan snimak slobodne igre.');
    } else if (mode === 'classic') {
      if (data.v !== 2 || !Number.isFinite(data.at) || !Number.isFinite(data.x) || data.x < 0 || data.x > 6400 ||
        !Number.isFinite(data.y) || data.y < 0 || data.y > 4600) throw Error('Neispravan 2D snimak.');
    } else throw Error('Nepoznat režim snimka.');
    if (data.kbDirector !== undefined) {
      const s = root.validate(data.kbDirector), b = s.campaign.legacy.beta;
      if (mode === 'story' && (!b || b.complete || b.chapter !== data.chapter || b.step !== data.step))
        throw Error('Pozicija i Director priča nisu iz istog trenutka.');
    }
    return true;
  }
  function nativeRestore(data, mode) {
    validateNative(data, mode);
    if (data.kbDirector !== undefined) return D.restore(data.kbDirector, true);
    if (mode === 'story') return D.beginBeta(data.flags || {});
    return true;
  }
  function transaction(entries, after) {
    const before = entries.map(([k]) => [k, localStorage.getItem(k)]);
    try {
      for (const [k, value] of entries) localStorage.setItem(k, value);
      if (after) after();
    } catch (e) {
      let rollback = true;
      for (const [k, value] of before) try { if (value === null) localStorage.removeItem(k); else localStorage.setItem(k, value); }
      catch (_) { rollback = false; }
      D.reload();
      throw Error(rollback ? 'Snimak nije učitan. Prethodni podaci su vraćeni.' : 'Čuvanje je prekinuto. Sačuvaj rezervnu kopiju.');
    }
  }
  const adapters = Object.freeze({safe, validateNative, nativeRestore,
    connect(engine, host) {
      if (!['2d', '3d'].includes(engine) || !host || typeof host !== 'object') throw Error('Neispravan adapter pogona.');
      if (hosts.has(engine)) throw Error('Adapter je već povezan.'); hosts.set(engine, Object.freeze(host));
    },
    host: engine => hosts.get(engine) || null,
    capture() { if (D.status.blocked) return undefined; D.flush(); return D.serialize(); },
    prepareImport(values) {
      const next = Object.assign({}, values);
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(next, root.key)) root.validate(JSON.parse(next[root.key]));
      else next[root.key] = JSON.stringify(D.migrated(next));
      return next;
    },
    loadSlot(slot) {
      window.KBStoryExtensions?.suspend();
      const keys = {story: 'kb_cinema_story_v5', free: 'kb_real_free_v1'};
      if (!slot || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(keys, slot.mode) || slot.key !== keys[slot.mode]) throw Error('Neispravan slot.');
      validateNative(slot.data, slot.mode);
      if (D.status.dirty && !D.flush()) throw Error('Prvo sačuvaj trenutni napredak. Skladište nije dostupno.');
      const previous = D.serialize();
      let snapshot = slot.data.kbDirector;
      if (!snapshot) {
        snapshot = D.migrated({[slot.key]: JSON.stringify(slot.data)});
        snapshot.campaign.legacy.classic = previous.campaign.legacy.classic;
        for (const id of ['legacy.2d.supplies', 'legacy.2d.explore', 'legacy.2d.descent'])
          if (previous.campaign.missions[id]) snapshot.campaign.missions[id] = previous.campaign.missions[id];
      }
      const oldRaw = localStorage.getItem(root.key);
      // restore spaja trajna otključavanja; privremeni tok priče ostaje vezan za slot.
      D.restore(snapshot, true);
      if (!D.status.durable) { D.reload(); throw Error('Nema mesta za napredak misija.'); }
      const merged = D.serialize(), data = Object.assign({}, slot.data, {kbDirector: merged});
      if (!slot.data.kbDirector && slot.mode === 'story') data.step = Math.min(data.step, [7, 5, 2][data.chapter]);
      try {
        transaction([[slot.key, JSON.stringify(data)]], () => {
          if (!window.KBBeta3D || window.KBBeta3D.loadSaved(slot.mode) === false) throw Error('Pogon nije dostupan.');
        });
      } catch (e) {
        if (oldRaw === null) localStorage.removeItem(root.key); else localStorage.setItem(root.key, oldRaw);
        D.reload(); throw e;
      }
      return true;
    }
  });
  window.KBMissionDirector = Object.freeze({create: root.create, validate: root.validate, key: root.key, instance: D, adapters});
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-rewards-a2">
/* A2: izgled je izbor igrača; podrazumevani modeli ostaju originalni. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const D = window.KBMissionDirector.instance, KEY = 'kb_director_look_v1';
  const looks = [
    {id:'original',title:'Originalni izgled',color:null,shade:null,mission:null,description:'Prepoznatljiva odeća ekipe.'},
    {id:'supply',title:'Boja ekipe',color:'#d9ac55',shade:'#aa7d32',mission:'legacy.2d.supplies',description:'Zlatno-oker majica za završene Zalihe za ekipu.'},
    {id:'forest',title:'Šumska putanja',color:'#658b70',shade:'#45634c',mission:'legacy.2d.explore',description:'Zelena majica za Istraživača brda.'},
    {id:'signal',title:'Poslednji signal',color:'#7ebbc6',shade:'#507f91',mission:'legacy.3d.station',description:'Ledeno-plava majica za završetak stare 3D priče.'}
  ];
  let selected = 'original', blocked = false, durable = true, rawSeen, awards = {}, palette = null;
  const cache = new WeakMap();
  function validate(v) {
    if (!v || Object.getPrototypeOf(v) !== Object.prototype || v.version !== 1 ||
      Object.keys(v).some(k => !['kind','version','selected'].includes(k)) ||
      v.kind !== 'kb-director-look' || !looks.some(x => x.id === v.selected))
      throw Error('Nepoznat ili oštećen zapis izgleda.');
    return {kind:v.kind,version:1,selected:v.selected};
  }
  function refresh() {
    awards = D.serialize().profile.awards;
    const entry = looks.find(x => x.id === selected);
    palette = entry && (!entry.mission || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(awards,entry.mission)) ? entry : looks[0];
  }
  function reload() {
    try {
      rawSeen = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY);
      selected = rawSeen === null ? 'original' : validate(JSON.parse(rawSeen)).selected;
      blocked = false; durable = true;
    } catch (e) { selected = 'original'; blocked = true; durable = false; D.report('look-read',e); }
    refresh();
  }
  function select(id) {
    const look = looks.find(x => x.id === id);
    if (blocked || !look || look.mission && !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(awards,look.mission)) return false;
    try {
      const current = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY);
      if (current !== rawSeen) { reload(); return false; }
      const raw = JSON.stringify({kind:'kb-director-look',version:1,selected:id});
      window.localStorage.setItem(KEY,raw); rawSeen = raw; selected = id; durable = true; refresh(); return true;
    } catch (e) { durable = false; D.report('look-write',e); return false; }
  }
  function role(original, index) {
    if (!palette.color || index !== 0) return original;
    let variants = cache.get(original);
    if (!variants) { variants = new Map(); cache.set(original,variants); }
    if (!variants.has(palette.id)) variants.set(palette.id,Object.freeze({...original,
      shirt:palette.color,shirtShade:palette.shade,coat:palette.color}));
    return variants.get(palette.id);
  }
  reload();
  D.subscribe(refresh);
  window.addEventListener('storage',e => { if (e.key === KEY || e.key === null) reload(); });
  window.KBRewardsA2 = Object.freeze({key:KEY,validate,reload,select,role,
    get classicColor(){return palette.color;},
    get status(){return {selected:palette.id,requested:selected,blocked,durable};},
    catalog(){return looks.map(x => ({...x,unlocked:!x.mission || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(awards,x.mission)}));}
  });
})();

</script>
<script id="kb-board-model-a2">

(() => {

    'legacy.2d.descent':{where:'Vrh Kalač brda → Grobarsko',hook:'Ko poslednji stigne, plaća burek.',hint:'Posle istraživanja idi na vrh. Ulazak u zonu pokreće trku do Grobarskog.',unit:'spust',prerequisite:'legacy.2d.explore'},

    'legacy.3d.power':{where:'Durmitorska',hook:'Bandere šalju SOS.',hint:'Priča se nastavlja posle parkića. Lazar očitava impuls prve bandere.',unit:'zadataka',prerequisite:'legacy.3d.park'},
    'legacy.3d.station':{where:'Ukleta meteo stanica',hook:'Ovog puta čuješ Perin pravi glas.',hint:'Prati trag posle Durmitorske. Na stanici će biti potrebna sva trojica.',unit:'zadataka',prerequisite:'legacy.3d.power'}
